Class TaskStore

java.lang.Object
taskflow.TaskStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.lang.AutoCloseable
public final class TaskStore extends java.lang.Object implements java.lang.AutoCloseable
Stores one workspace as UTF-8 properties and locks it for the editing session.
